products.title: The Top Game Toolkit by Owen Livesey
products.body:
Dominate The Top Game In All Aspects And Start Moving And Attacking With Confident With This Series From Judo Black Belt And BJJ Black Belt Owen Livesey

  • All matches start standing, so begin by learning the proper ways to hand-fight to gain the advantage right off the bat
  • Dive in to a series of takedowns by utilizing the snap down, fireman's carry, Sumi Gaeshi, and so much more
  • Work diligently to learn how to effectively pass a seated guard using the Toreando pass and grips like the upside down C grip
  • Master the art of passing the open guard with double unders and smash passing techniques
  • If you find yourself in deep waters, utilize the triangle and Kimura counters shown in this series to leave your opponent speechless
  • Quickly pass the guard and work to take the back and work to submissions of your own before your opponent knows what hit them!

products.title: The B Team Top Game: How to Work Against Seated Guards, Supine Guards, and Those Trying to Stand Up by Craig Jones
products.body:
Learn the B-Team top game, including how to work against seated guards, supine guards, and those trying to stand up 

  • Force errors and exploit common mistakes with Craig’s techniques for passing - including stacks, torreandos, leg drags, and more
  • See some of the best ways to clear out of dangerous leg entanglements with leg locking master Craig’s advice
  • Craig is one of the most popular instructors in the world, with ADCC Medals & sustained elite competition success
  • This six-part series will help you understand how to approach and think about playing top in no-gi, and how you can begin to enforce your rhythm and method against your opponents

Redefine No-Gi Guard Passing With Australian Grappling Superstar Craig Jones As He Explains His System For Passing Against Tough Guards And Disengaging Dangerous Positions


What Will You Learn?

See your top game get better than ever with no-gi grappling star Craig Jones’s six-part series on guard passing concepts and techniques that you can use to better your skills. With coaching on how to break down the guard, including how he approaches seated guard, supine guard, and opponents determined to stand up, Craig shows a complete guard passing class for grapplers of all levels.

Use conceptual lessons like how to score your passes through fatigue, and how important the hip pocket is to every pass, as Craig shows you ways to make guard passing a lot simpler through easy adjustments. With drills and techniques built on a strong base of experience in competition against the best, Craig can show you what really works when you want to get to a dominant position and what mistakes people are commonly making.

Craig Jones is one of the most popular grapplers and instructors in the world, with an ADCC medal from 2019 and many elite victories against some of the best in the game. Use Craig’s coaching on leg drags, stacks, torreandos, body locks, and more as he shows you how to approach a dangerous guard and defuse the situation.

Don’t get caught up in those tricky leg entanglements again, Craig explains here on this six-volume series how to avoid those positions and even how to clear from dangerous positions like shin on shin and ashi garami. Combine your techniques into one system with Craig’s help as he shows you all the ways to shut down bottom fighters and be the power top on the mats.

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

PART 1

  • INTRODUCTION
  • REDEFINING THE BOTTOM POSITION
  • REMOVING GUARD: 3 TYPES OF BOTTOM
  • FORCED ERRORS
  • SCORE FATIGUE NOT POINTS

products.title: Top Game Tool Box: Tilts & Bars by Max Askren
products.body:
NCAA Champ Max Askren Teaches His Wrestling Blueprint For The Tightest Pinning Combinations Possible From Top Position With Armbars and Tilts

  • Lock up armbars and tilts from top position and turn even the most stubborn opponents with Max Askren’s guide to scoring from top
  • Max Askren is an NCAA Champion for the University of Missouri who runs one of America’s most successful youth clubs, Askren Wrestling Academy
  • Use cross wrist tilts, roll through tilts, bars, turks, and more to constantly chain together turns from top
  • Level up your mat wrestling with these techniques for controlling, breaking down, and turning your opponents with step-by-step technique


NCAA Champ Max Askren Teaches His Wrestling Blueprint For The Tightest Pinning Combinations Possible From Top Position With Armbars and Tilts

 

 

Get rolling from top position and start using these bars, tilts, and more to systematically break down opponents with Max Askren’s 2-part series. With these techniques and combinations from top, you’ll be able to chain moves together and still turn talented opponents with leverage and positioning.

Learn How To Wrestle Dynamically From The Top Position

 

 

Askren will guide you from set up to finish as he provides multiple methods to attack the low single, including head inside and head outside variations. You’ll expand your toolbox with technical teaching, derived from the highest levels of wrestling and unmatched experience. To round out the series, Askren will cover defensive measures, so you can shut down the low single when it's coming from the other direction and you won’t want to miss “The world's best unknown move” near the end of the instructional!

Win From Top With These Proven Tilts and Turns

 

 

Turn with cross wrist tilts, roll through tils, and more as Max explains the best ways to find these super effective moves. Secure the tightest bars possible and attack in combination with half nelsons and tilts that keep you on offense and working for the fall.

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1:

  • Hand Fighting
  • Cross Wrist Drill
  • Breakdown Drill
  • Cross Wrist Tilt
  • Cross Wrist Roll Through Tilt
  • Elbow In Roll Through Tilt
  • Reinforced Bar
  • Reinforced Bar From Belly

Part 2

  • Transition to Turk
  • Turning Drill
  • Cross Wrist Tilt Changing Sides
  • Bars
  • Bar In Hal
  • Bar Tilt
  • Outro

So, What Does It Cost?
